items.title: Exact integer arithmetic

items.title: Genuine checkpoint qualification

items.title: Constant grounding
items.rationale: Exact affine/nonlinear classification, modular pivots and rank deficiency, genuine QF_NIA/BV distinction, recurrence structure/cache, measured outcomes and final verification.

items.title: Common execution
items.rationale: Lower before compile, four results, pure/batch/native parity and typed optimizer local.tee/control/trap correctness.

items.title: Immediate symbolic proof soundness
items.rationale: Repair both existing APIs, controlled symbol table, shifted domains/poles, scoped certificates and concrete disproof witnesses before experiments.

items.title: Data eligibility and isolation
items.rationale: Exact indexed truth, finite/table/growth metadata, separate horizons, affine/shift grouping, synthetic structure/parameter/operator holdouts.

items.title: RL policy mathematics
items.rationale: Real behavior probabilities/support, frozen encoder+decoder, forced-action exclusion, module modes, entropy/variance and real trace evidence.

items.title: Reproducibility and infrastructure
items.rationale: Complete active checkpoints, truthful metrics/config, external hashes, clean wheel/resources, actual native CI and shared lifecycle.

items.title: Generation performance
items.rationale: KV and cross-projection caches, batching/buffers, dynamic masks, invalidation and equivalence; actual end-to-end timings.

items.title: Typed representation and complete codec
items.rationale: Complete constants/locals, typed logical WAT, consistent EOS/wrapper/length, atomic elite/CGI eligibility and long-program archive.

items.title: Generic data and self-training
items.rationale: Diverse generic constructs, parameter/family isolation, multiple implementations/Pareto archive, near-miss training reuse and revalidation.

items.title: Bounded search
items.rationale: Sampling/beam/repair, skeleton cache, sound pruning, visible counterexamples and permitted retrieval; equal-budget selection.

items.title: Curriculum/replay defects
items.rationale: Per-visit observations, actual adaptive allocations, uncertainty/cost/exploration, nonzero replay gradients and complete state.

items.title: Runtime expressiveness and resource calibration
items.rationale: Pure plus streaming/block and arrays, full wide ops, reset/state parity, calibrated bounded fuel tiers and near-limit counts.

items.title: Exact input representation
items.rationale: Signed bytes and rebased indices, exact differences/residues, parity/powers-of-two, active heads and bounded prefix/encoder comparisons.

items.title: Ryzen configuration
items.rationale: Actual GPU updates, Docker AMD identity/shared-memory accounting, synchronized sustained timing, finite AMP and bounded4/8-worker comparisons.

items.title: Generated-program discovery
items.rationale: Archive-derived graph/features/transforms, multiple implementations, checked typed rewrites/learned macros and post-seal novelty.

items.title: Relation-search defects
items.rationale: Ranked bounded retrieval, actual configured multi-index exact nullspace, nonempty disjoint validation, honest metrics and negative controls.

items.title: Scoped proof capabilities
items.rationale: Polynomial/rational, recurrence, finite-state, restricted-loop and bounded-machine certificates with domain/compiler-link limits and independent replay.

items.title: Position and capacity decisions
items.rationale: Keep sinusoidal baseline, fixture-test RoPE/ancestor-path/25M-class options, select at most one triggered paired contrast; no future AST leakage or assumed superiority.

items.title: Sinusoidal corruption
items.rationale: Unsupported defect diagnosis; no such claim adopted.

items.title: Fixed positional-buffer crash
items.rationale: Dynamic extension already exists; retain long-length regression instead of inventing a missing fix.

items.title: RoPE
items.rationale: Implemented selectable variant, cache-offset tests and bounded conditional comparison.

items.title: Unconstrained RoPE extrapolation
items.rationale: Reject guarantee; explicit length/cache/memory limits and held-out length evidence.

items.title: Depth/sibling Tree-RoPE
items.rationale: Replace colliding coordinates with generated-prefix ancestor paths; binding remains statically checked.

items.title: Consolidated lifecycle
items.rationale: Shared launch/resume/canaries/stages plus original-wrapper parity.

items.title: Extraction/manifests
items.rationale: Indexed sources, checksums, synthetic identity, group split and shared extraction.

items.title: Four-horizon census
items.rationale: Separate20/50/100/120 complete denominators and exact signed range.

items.title: Qualification CLI
items.rationale: Actual checkpoint synthesis and machine-readable gates; reference diagnostics separate.

items.title: All logic in CLI classes
items.rationale: Reusable services with thin CLI adapters; classes only for stateful needs.

items.title: Additional command aliases
items.rationale: Existing oeis-learn command namespace suffices; optional names are not a defect.

items.title: Retire obsolete wrappers
items.rationale: Archive after parity with original configs and evidence preserved.

items.title: 512 default or RoPE removes limits
items.rationale: Existing dynamic buffer plus one explicit context contract; no unlimited length claim.

items.title: 85+160 universal token minimum
items.rationale: Actual body/wrapper/BOS/EOS accounting; fixed benchmark estimate is not universal.

items.title: Elite canonical limit
items.rationale: Repair legacy insertion-before-validation and retain valid long programs outside training.

items.title: CGI length guard
items.rationale: Existing guard becomes profile-derived with common eligibility, not hardcoded512.

items.title: Static helper fuel estimates
items.rationale: Actual per-call and aggregate fuel measured; no copied instruction estimate.

items.title: 25k–50k fuel thresholds
items.rationale: Insufficient thresholds rejected; bounded100k/250k/1M tiers and aggregate accounting.

items.title: 75% fuel warnings
items.rationale: Configurable near-limit counts and summaries, not a learned optimum.

items.title: Historical generation timings
items.rationale: Historical G16 bottleneck is evidence; actual Ryzen phase timings still required.

items.title: KV caching
items.rationale: Include self/cross caches with bounded state/equivalence and measured benefit.

items.title: Attention complexity
items.rationale: Correct aggregate dense attention O(T^3) to O(T^2), not O(T^2) to O(T); no universal speed promise.

items.title: 3–5x cache speedup
items.rationale: Unverified projection rejected; use measured practical-effect rule.

items.title: Grammar allocation work
items.rationale: Instrument actual sets/loops/synchronization; do not assert143 checks per step universally.

items.title: uint128 masks
items.rationale: Reject insufficient width; sized boolean/word masks cover the full vocabulary.

items.title: Batched grammar masks
items.rationale: Preallocated static components plus dynamic stack/local/scope state.

items.title: 1.5–2x grammar gain
items.rationale: Measure end-to-end and phase costs without multiplying speculative gains.

items.title: CUDA deployment
items.rationale: AMD-compatible Docker runtime and actual HIP tensors, not NVIDIA wheels.

items.title: Weight/VRAM size
items.rationale: Record actual parameters and peak shared-host/device memory; weight storage is not full footprint.

items.title: GPU 10x/sub50ms claim
items.rationale: Unsupported bound rejected; synchronized steady-state end-to-end measurements.

items.title: Entropy/ACR causal claim
items.rationale: Repair unrestricted entropy/proxy fields and measure actual group variance; no invented historical causality.

items.title: Temperature lower bound
items.rationale: 0.8 explicit baseline, not an established optimum; changing schedule requires one selected contrast.

items.title: AST solver routing
